text: US 12 milepost 154 White Pass: Wednesday Oct. 7 until 3 p.m. there will be alternating pilot car directed traffic for ditching work.
Eastbound & westbound traffic is alternating on SR 542 at Glacier Springs Way (MP 30) due to roadwork.
Both directions milepost 155 White Pass. Until further notice, there will be alternating flag-controlled traffic 24/7, and an 11-foot width restriction for paving work. Expect some added travel time.

Overnight closure of SR 706 on October 16; no access to Nisqually Entrance.. SR706 outside of the park will be fully CLOSED overnight from 9 pm Friday 10/16 until 6 am Saturday 10/17, for road repairs to replace a failing culvert. The closure will be from Kernahan Road East to the Nisqually Entrance. There will be NO ACCESS to the Nisqually Entrance during the closure. To reach Paradise during the closure plan to enter the park through the Stevens Canyon Entrance via SR123 on the east side of the park.
Flaggers will alternate traffic through the 636th Place Northeast intersection from 8 a.m. to 3 p.m. Monday, Oct. 12, for utility work.
